source.gives: Heating values MJ/kg: coke 23 to 32 (FAO 28.4), hard coal 29.3, anthracite 31.4, dry wood 18 to 20, air-dried 15.5, charcoal about 30.8 (one study); bagasse dry about 19.3 to 19.4 MJ/kg, 45 to 53 per cent moisture as fired; peat the Dutch main fuel, coal four times peat per unit (one source); whale oil main lamp fuel 18th and 19th c, kerosene from about 1860; no flame temperatures found
